content.text: Kentucky Derby The greatest two minutes in sports, Kentucky Derby at Churchill Downs is the highest attended horse race in the United States. Home > Come To The Derby > Derby Week Events > Kentucky Derby KENTUCKY DERBY: RUN FOR THE ROSES® PRESENTED BY WOODFORD RESERVE Saturday, May 2, 2026 | Gates Open: 9 a.m. ET | First Race: 11:00 a.m. ET No other entertainment event is as alluring, captivating, and thrilling as the Kentucky Derby. Call it what you will—the Run for the Roses®, the Most Exciting Two Minutes in Sports®, or America's Race. This year marks the 152nd running of the Kentucky Derby, presented by Woodford Reserve, the first leg of the Triple Crown. More than just a horse race, it’s a tradition steeped in history and held in the heart of America. It’s a way of life, representing the hopes and dreams of millions across the globe. EVENT DAY DETAILS KENTUCKY DERBY | SATURDAY, MAY 2 Gates Open: 9 a.m. ET | First Post: 11:00 a.m. ET View Post Times & Wagering > Where to Watch View broadcast schedules and get the latest updates on where watch or listen to the Kentucky Derby. Watch and Follow the Kentucky Derby EVENT DAY HIGHLIGHTS To be announced! PARKING INFORMATION Onsite Parking Onsite parking is sold out. For those with passes, lots open at 8:00 am on Oaks and Derby days. Some tickets include parking (e.g., The Mansion, Spires Terrace, Woodford Reserve Paddock Club, Suites, Matt Winn’s, and select dining rooms). Passes are vehicle-specific (car, limo, mini-bus, motor coach). Wrong vehicle types will be denied entry. Follow directions to your assigned lot. Entry is unique to each lot. No shuttling within lots. No re-entry if you exit. Central Avenue will be CLOSED May 1–3. Visit kentuckyderbyparking.com for details. Buses and cars can pre-purchase a Derby Drive drop-off pass (Warren Ave between Queen & Thornberry). No pickups. Passes are collected at drop-off. Kentucky Exposition Center (KEC) Shuttles run from 7:30 am on Oaks and Derby days. ADA parking and shuttles are available, but no wheelchair assistance at Churchill Downs. Enter through Gates 1 or 2. KEC shuttles are for frontside ticket holders only. No Infield ticket entry or drop-off. Frontside tickets include free shuttle access between KEC and Churchill Downs. Rideshare & Pickup No onsite taxi or rideshare drop-off/pick-up. Use the Bronze Lot at L&N Federal Credit Union Stadium. No mobility assistance to/from Churchill Downs. Guests must shuttle to KEC for access. Paid parking at L&N Stadium begins on Thurby. Walk to Churchill Downs. Pay on-site (cash or card): $40 (car), $150 (RV), $200 (bus). ADA Parking During Derby Week, onsite parking at Churchill Downs is available for pre-purchase as long as inventory is available. Parking within each reserved lot is first-come, first-served including ADA spaces. If you do not have pre-purchased parking onsite, the Kentucky Exposition Center will have free parking with free accessible shuttles to the Black Lot outside of the Paddock Gate.
